Unaltered 1448 by 1086 generated PNG masters. The matching shipping assets,
encoder and design intent are recorded in taffy-task-scenes.txt beside this
record. The exact generation prompts are kept in the maintainer's working
tree and are not published. Neither master uses an input image or copies an
Aster asset.
